title: Isolation and culture of human alveolar epithelial progenitor cells
protocol: Warm digestion solution in 37°C water bath while preparing lungs.
Remove all pleura from large piece of human lung carefully.
Cut lung into 6-10 individual small pieces (~300mg).
Place cut lung pieces in ice cold PBS with anti-anti and antibiotics.
Weigh the chopped lung tissue.
Collect ~300 mg of dissected lung tissue in a gentleMACS tube.
Add 5 ml of digestion solution to each tube containing chopped lung tissue.
Place all gentleMACS tubes onto the Dissociator.
Snap tube into place to ensure it is tight.
Add heating elements to the tubes.
Run the “m_lung_01_02” program 3-5 times.
Check MACS tubes after running; there should be no large clumps of tissue in the fluid.
Remove cap and dislodge any junk from the cap into the bottom if an error occurs, then repeat.
Run the “37C_m_LIDK_1” program for 35 minutes.
Filter through a 70 micron MACSsmart cell strainer into a new 50mL tube.
Rinse 10-20 mL PBS through the 70 micron cell strainer to maximize yield; remove large chunks of debris if clogging occurs.
Spin at 450x g for 10 min at 4°C; spin an additional 4 minutes if pellet is fluffy.
Decant supernatant carefully.
Add 10mL of ACK Lysis buffer and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes to lyse RBCs.
Spin at 450x g for 5 min at 4°C, then discard the supernatant.
Repeat step if many RBCs remain.
Wash cells with 5-10mL FACS buffer; spin at 450x g for 5 min and repeat washing steps 2-3 times.
Filter through a 40uM cell strainer.
Stain cells with Trypan Blue and count via hemocytometer.
Place samples on ice while awaiting further steps.
Proceed to FACS, bead sorting, cytospins, RNA isolation, etc from this point.
Use the Miltenyi MACS bead sorting kits and follow the manufacturer’s protocol.
Place the cell suspension in a 15 mL tube.
Spin at 300-450x g for 5 minutes, remove supernatant, and resuspend pellet in primary antibody in FACS buffer.
If sorting for AEPs, use both primary antibodies together. For HT2-280 use a 1:50 dilution and for TM4SF1 use a 1:100 dilution. Use a total volume of 2 mLs.
Incubate at 4°C in the dark for 1 hour.
Wash twice with 10 ml FACS buffer.
Incubate in MACS secondary anti-IgM-magnetic beads in FACS buffer (200 μl antibody to 800 μL FACS buffer) for 30 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Wash once with 10 ml FACS buffer and spin at 450x g for 4 min.
Evaluate the number of cells from step 18. Load no more than 2 million cells per Miltenyi LS column for magnetic sorting.
Choose the number of columns you will use for sorting and resuspend in 1 mL per column (usually about 5-10 million cells, so 5-10 ml) of FACS buffer. Place on ice.
Prepare Miltenyi LS columns for sorting per the manufacturer protocol. Add 3 ml of FACS buffer to prepare the columns.
Add 1-2 mL of cells per column.
Wash each column 3 times with 3 mL of FACs buffer.
Remove columns from magnet, and place on a suitable collection tube.
Add 5 mL of FACs buffer and immediately flush out the magnetically labeled cells by pushing the plunger into the column.
Centrifuge sorted cells at 300-450 g for 5 minutes at 4°C in 15 mL tubes.
Remove supernatant, and incubate with 1 mL of FACs buffer and 20 μL of MultiSort Release Reagent.
Mix well and incubate for 10 minutes in the dark at 4°C.
Wash cells by adding 1 mL of FACs buffer per 1 million cells, then centrifuge at 300-450 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells at a final concentration of no more than 10^7 total cells per 50 μL of buffer.
Add 30 μL of MultiSort Stop Reagent per 10^7 total cells and mix well.
Add 200 μL of anti-APC-magnetic beads to 800 μL of FACs buffer per pellet.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Wash once with 10 mL FACS buffer and spin at 300-450 x g for 4 minutes.
Resuspend in 1 mL of FACS buffer for each 1 million cells.
Load and wash the LS columns as noted in steps 28-31 above.
Collect the flow through from all washes; this is the Tm4sf1 negative fraction of AT2 cells.
Add 5 mL of FACs buffer to each column, remove from magnet, and immediately flush out the magnetically labeled cells by firmly pushing the plunger into the column.
This population of cells are HT280+Tm4sf1+ human AEPs.
Prepare Tissue Culture Media using MTEC plus media supplemented with antibiotics for lung organoids.
Use Anti-/Anti- to prevent contamination; both mycobacterial and fungal infection are issues, particularly in human samples.
Prefer freshly prepared Lonza SAGM media, prepared within the last month, aliquoted into small aliquots and used rapidly.
Use MTEC/Plus or SAGM supplemented with ROCK inhibitor for the first 48 hours of culture.
Maintain media at 4°C until use to avoid rapid polymerization with Matrigel.
Prepare matrigel the night before planned culture; thaw working aliquots on ice overnight in a cold room at 4°C.
Test each lot of Matrigel and use lots with best colony forming efficiency to minimize assay variability.
Keep Matrigel liquid at 4°C and mix only with other reagents at 4°C until ready for use.
Use low passage MCR5 cells (ATCC) for organoid preparation; these grow better than primary human fibroblasts.
Lift MCR5 cells from the plate using 0.25% trypsin on the day of organoid prep to create a single cell suspension.
Wash the fibroblast pellet with PBS and resuspend in SAGM or MTEC/Plus media at a recommended concentration of 5-10k fibroblasts/ul.
Use transwell inserts specifically designed for 24 well plates to place cultures; using other formats can lead to evaporation of media.
Prepare and label wells, and place inserts in wells.
Fill unused wells with sterile PBS to prevent evaporation of tissue culture media.
Place transwell plate in refrigerator or on ice until ready to use.
Use chilled plates and reagents for proper settling of cultures prior to matrigel polymerization.
Avoid bubbles in all mixtures to avoid disruption of 3D structures.
Mix 5k epithelial cells with 50k fibroblasts in a total volume of 45ul MTEC/Plus or SAGM without Rock inhibitor per well.
Make a master mix of all cells at the ratio for the number of wells needed, and mix well before adding matrigel.
Add 45ul of matrigel per well to cell mixture; final concentration is 1:1 media to matrigel.
Gently mix after addition of matrigel without introducing air bubbles.
Pipette 90ul final mixture into each well of a 24 well transwell insert.
Pipette into the middle of the insert, avoid bubbles, and ensure smooth and even covering of the insert.
Place plate at 37°C for 10-15 minutes.
Warm MTEC/Plus or SAGM supplemented with Rock inhibitor (10uM) during this time.
Add 500 μl of SAGM media into the bottom chamber of the transwell plate.
Place plate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for incubation.
Change media in the lower well every 48 hours using SAGM or MTEC/Plus without Rock inhibitor starting on the first change.
Add treatment with small molecules or signaling factors after 48 hours to allow establishment of culture and continue adding fresh factor every 48 hours throughout the experiment.
Culture for 14-21 days prior to analysis.
